scenarios.source: 07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §3 (Bull/Base/Bear table — 'Implied P/E' and 'Implied P/BV' columns); FY26 EPS (reported) INR 1.98 and BV/share INR 19.39 per that report's anchor block. This case's LEVEL is IMPLIED, not applied: §2/§4 build every scenario as a 70%/30% blend of the RI (residual-income) model and the peer method, not a single EPS x P/E — for bull: `04_intrinsic-dcf.md` §3 RI bull INR 25.70 x 0.70 = INR 17.99, plus peer at the undiscounted SAHI-median 43.75x LTM P/E on EPS 1.98 = INR 86.63 x 0.30 = INR 25.99; sum = INR 43.98 (§3's stated bull driver: 'peer re-rates to full SAHI median (no quality discount)'). The recorded P/E (22.2121) is the ratio the LEVEL implies on that EPS, at full precision — a cross-check reading, not the derivation: the table's 1dp reading (22.2x) would move the frozen level by up to INR 0.08.

This case's LEVEL is IMPLIED, not applied: §4 builds the bear as a 70%/30% blend of the RI bear scenario and the peer P/TBV bear (NOT the peer P/E used by bull/base) — RI bear INR 15.40 x 0.70 = INR 10.78, plus peer P/TBV at 1.0x on TBV/share INR 19.11 = INR 19.11 x 0.30 = INR 5.73; sum = INR 16.51 (§4's own executed snippet: 'bear_fv = 0.70 x 15.40 + 0.30 x 19.11 = 10.78 + 5.73 = INR 16.51').
